messages:
cleo_devex: Quick heads-up 15m quiet window starting for SDK publish (22:45 UTC). We'll run py and ts canaries. Please stop publish PRs.

publish-bot: publish-request received for @redwood/sdk-js (canary). job: canary-js-4150005000 queued.

sam_eng: seeing `npm ERR! E403` at the publish step; logs show `You do not have permission to publish`. CI uses NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN. Did we rotate permissions?

ben_releases: I rotated the token yesterday and scoped it to package:read only by mistake. switching to machine token with write perms now.

publish-bot: canary-js-4150005065 retry -> job started.

sam_eng: js canary uploaded and served to 5% traffic. no runtime errors in smoke tests.

cleo_devex: leave py canary queued but do not flip dist-tag until I confirm both are green. marta, hold changelog.

marta_docs: got it 1 will only publish once you give the go-ahead.

publish-bot: publish-request received for @redwood/sdk-py (canary). job: canary-py-4150005110 queued.

sam_eng: py canary failed artifact verification: checksum mismatch for wheel `redwood_sdk-3.4.0-py3-none-any.whl`.

ben_releases: proposal: pin python dist-tag to 3.3.7 (previous) and cancel py GA. we'll repack and re-sign the wheel.

cleo_devex: decision: pin py -> 3.3.7 now, proceed with js GA tomorrow main window if no regressions. I'll open a quick PR to pin and notify support.

cleo_devex: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1333 1 pin py dist-tag to 3.3.7 and add rollback checklist.

sam_eng: re-signing wheel locally, ETA ~20m. will push to staging and request a republish canary.

publish-bot: canary-js-4150005065 now at 15% traffic. canary-py-4150005110 canceled per request.

marta_docs: standing by to draft release notes; please ping when both canaries are green.

ben_releases: INF-2310 created to track repack/sign/verify and downstream checks. tagging release-metrics.

publish-bot: thread archived: publish window complete.
